caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling an old-fashioned flat iron, placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The iron has a thick, rectangular base with a rough, textured surface suggesting it is made of heavy metal. Emerging from the center of the base, there is a hollow, irregularly shaped handle with rounded edges, looped in a continuous form and attached at both ends to the base. The object is rendered entirely in shades of gray, with detailed shading used to indicate depth, roughness, and metallic texture. There is a signature in the lower left corner that reads "Maurice Van Felix."
title: Flatiron
